req.title: Task title max length
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title exceeds the maximum length constraint.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the task title exceeds the maximum length constraint. This is a functional requirement that ensures data integrity and prevents invalid data from being processed. The test suite includes a positive case to verify normal operation, a negative case to test the error pathway, and a boundary case to ensure the system correctly handles edge conditions.

tests.name: Create task with valid title length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of exactly 100 characters.
expected: The response contains the created task with the specified title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

valid_title = 'a' * 100
response = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': valid_title, 'description': 'Valid description', 'completed': False})

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()['title'] == valid_title

tests.name: Create task with title exceeding max length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of 101 characters.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the title length constraint.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_title = 'a' * 101
response = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': invalid_title, 'description': 'Invalid description', 'completed': False})

assert response.status_code == 422
assert 'title' in response.json()['detail'][0]['loc']
assert response.json()['detail'][0]['msg'] == 'ensure this value has at most 100 characters'

tests.name: Create task with title at max length boundary
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of 100 characters.
expected: The response contains the created task with the specified title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_title = 'a' * 100
response = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': boundary_title, 'description': 'Boundary description', 'completed': False})

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()['title'] == boundary_title
